section.title: Basic function
section.p: Smart Cruise Control operates under the following conditions:

li.p: The gear is in D (Drive).
Your speed is within the operating range:
MT (manual transmission): 20–180 km/h (13–110 mph)
AT (Automatic Transmission):
when there is no vehicle ahead: 10-180 km/h (5-110 mph)
when there is a vehicle ahead: 0-180 km/h (0-110 mph)
HEV: 0-140 km/h (0-90 mph)
Electronic Stability Control (ESC) or Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) is ON.
When the vehicle is stopped or traveling below 10 km/h (5 mph) with no vehicle detected ahead.
When the brake pedal is pressed while driving (excluding when stopped).

section.p: Smart Cruise Control does not operate in the following conditions.

li.p: The driver’s door is open.
Engine RPM is high.
Engine RPM is low (MT (manual transmission) models, if equipped).
Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) is engaged.
ESC or ABS is controlling the vehicle.
Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist brake control is operating.
Remote Smart Parking Assist brake control is operating (if equipped).
When the vehicle is stopped or traveling below 10 km/h (5 mph) with no vehicle detected ahead.
When the brake pedal is pressed while driving (excluding when stopped).

note.p: When you are stopped behind another vehicle, you can turn on Smart Cruise Control while the brake pedal is engaged (Except for MT (manual transmission)).

section.title: Overtaking Acceleration Assist function
section.p: Overtaking Acceleration Assist operates when you turn the turn signal indicator ON to the left (left-hand drive) or the right (right-hand drive) while Smart Cruise Control is operating under the following conditions:

li.p: Your speed is above 60 km/h (40 mph).
A vehicle is detected ahead of you.

section.p: Overtaking Acceleration Assist does not operate under the following conditions:

li.p: The hazard lights are ON.
You have reduced your speed to maintain following distance from a vehicle ahead.

When you turn the turn signal indicator ON to the left (left-hand drive) or the right (right-hand drive) while there is a vehicle ahead, your vehicle may accelerate temporarily. Always pay attention to the road conditions.

Regardless of your country’s driving direction, Overtaking Acceleration Assist operates when the conditions are satisfied. When using the function in countries with a different driving direction, always check the road conditions.
